author: reek
body: The classifier, one tag character per source character. Every line below is a shape the highlighter has to get right for a different reason, and the expected output names the class of every character, so a token that grows, shrinks or changes kind moves the line rather than passing quietly.

author: reek
body: The indent cases come first because the indent decides everything before any character is read. A `cites` at one space of indent is an English word inside a sentence and must come back as prose; the same word at two spaces is a directive. Those two lines differ by exactly one space and by nothing else, which is the point of running both.
